text:
Can you name all 6 things on the front of your ankle? 🦶 One sentence, medial → lateral: Tom Has Very Nice Dancing Pigs.

T → Tibialis anterior (most medial)
H → extensor Hallucis longus (to the big toe)
V → anterior tibial Vessels (artery + 2 veins)
N → deep fibular Nerve (old name: deep peroneal)
D → extensor Digitorum longus (to 4 toes)
P → Peroneus tertius = fibularis tertius (missing in some people)
All 6 cross the front of the ankle under the extensor retinacula.

Quick test in the video: which one becomes the pulse on top of your foot? (The anterior tibial artery → dorsalis pedis.)

Save this for your next anatomy exam.
